# pairwise-judge

> Pairwise LLM-as-judge comparing two responses in both orders to cancel position bias, with strict verdict parsing and win-rate summaries Python package `trysac-pairwise-judge`, import name `pairwise_judge`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
